relations.product: joint development and manufacture of new polymer materials for CO2 separation membranes
relations.quote: Under the agreement, the two companies will jointly develop and manufacture new polymer materials for use in CO₂ separation membranes and assess their suitability for industrial-scale production.
relations.label: Nitto Boseki press release: Nittobo and Aqualung Carbon Capture sign joint development (10-15-2026)
